title: Same Question, Seven Engines: What Each AI Search Engine Cited — a GEO Source-Forensics Case Study
description: One identical question, in English and Chinese, put to seven AI search surfaces on the same night; every cited URL captured, fetched, and classified by a frozen deterministic codebook. Reports cross-engine source overlap (domain-level Jaccard 0.171 CN / 0.091 EN), the page types engines actually cite, and the uptake of self-published ranked listicles. Ships the classification code and the per-page dossiers, so the offline half of the analysis can be recomputed bit-for-bit by anyone: `python3 scripts/classify.py` re-derives all 116 published page_type labels. v1.2 corrects four Cloudflare-blocked pages that were analysed from the interstitial rather than their recovered text; see ERRATUM.md.
